newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-"WE WANT THE POINTS," SAYS FURIOUS BLACKBURN MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-"WE WANT THE POINTS," SAYS FURIOUS BLACKBURN MANAGER.

text.p: Furious Blackburn manager Tony Parkes called on league officials to award his struggling side the points after Middlesbrough pulled out of their premier league clash on Saturday because they could not field a side.
Middlesbrough informed the league on Friday they could not put out a representative side because of injuries and a virus. Manager Bryan Robson said 23 of his professionals were ruled out.
"It's a totally unacceptable situation from our point of view," said Parkes who is in the job in a caretaker role until Sven Goran-Eriksson takes over in the summer.
"We are very disappointed by this. We were all geared up for what was a big game for us only to find out 24 hours beforehand that it won't be going ahead.
"In such circumstances, it's difficult to know what the punishment should be. But at this moment I believe we should be awarded the points, it's as simple as that.
"Every club has injury and illness problems...but you are obliged to fulfil your fixtures."
A league disciplinary panel will examine the decision to postpone the match next month.
